text:
priya: Heads up — the new PTQ int8 canary (raven-lite-int8) spiked funcall JSON parse failures on canary traffic this morning, ~1.8% -> 9.7%.
canary-bot: Canary alert: JSON_parse_rate for /invoke/toolcall exceeded threshold (5%) on raven-lite-int8 — window=15m.
jake: Oof. Any raw examples?
olga: Pasting a couple sanitized outputs we captured:

olga: {"action": "save_file", "args": {"path": "/tmp/log.txt", "mode": "w",}}

olga: trailing comma after mode — our JSON lib fails to parse that.
priya: Float16 canary wasn't showing this. Could be quantization noise causing the model to emit an extra comma token or an extra quote.
tim: Is it consistently a trailing comma, or are there other injects?
maria: I also saw some unescaped newlines inside strings: "note": "line1
line2" — breaks NDJSON ingestion.
jake: Quick triage proposal: 1) pause int8 rollout, 2) collect 1k failing examples, 3) token-level diff vs f16 mirror, 4) try lightweight postprocess heuristics (strip trailing commas / escape newlines).
priya: Paused the rollout already (done). Ops: can you confirm failing sample dump location?
canary-bot: Archive created: s3://canary-dumps/int8/176888/parse-failures-2026-03-21.tar.gz
olga: I'll run local repair heuristics: regex to remove trailing commas before parse, plus NDJSON line guards. Will report fix rate.
jake: If simple postprocessing recovers >90% we can consider a temporary postprocess layer, but that only buys time — we need a model fix.
priya: Longer term: try alternate PTQ config (different clipping / rounding) and re-run canary. Also try a low-temperature decode for the canary.
tim: I'll run token alignment diffs (int8 vs f16) on 500 samples — beam top-5 alignment to see where extra punctuation appears. Assign to me.
maria: Can we add granular failure metrics to dashboards: trailing_comma, unescaped_newline, invalid_escape, truncated_json?
priya: Owners: olga (postprocess prototype), tim (token-level diff + writeup), jake (canary rerun + metrics). I've pinged infra for additional logs and request to keep the dump for 7 days.
jake: I'll open a follow-up thread with diffs + decision by EOD.
priya: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
